tagline: Break a small electronics idea into a learnable prototype plan.
introduction: A maker companion for Atech.dev's modular electronics and learning context, helping organize components, questions and testable steps.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Atech.dev? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Design Atech.dev challenge support
capabilities.description: Atech physical-device integration owner. Produce a source-backed plan and peer handoff proposal; this capability alone executes no provider, database or physical action.
inputs: a scoped public or synthetic task and the exact challenge or integration question
outputs: Live useful device using actual Atech modules and AI; real-user/expert validation; four equally weighted criteria: usefulness, impact, Atech use, working demo/story
source references, dependencies and explicitly unverified actions
